definitions.explanation: Main or principal. A formal written word, used only directly before a noun.

examples.japanese: {主|しゅ}たる⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|しゅ}たる⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧{不足|ぶそく}だった。
examples.english: The main cause of the accident was poor maintenance.

examples.japanese: {本件|ほんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|しゅ}たる⟦{争点|そうてん}→争点：11468_souten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The main point at issue in this case is whether the contract was validly concluded.

notes:
Comes from the classical copula たり: {主|しゅ}たる = "which is main." It has no other forms: say ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧ in ordinary speech, and use ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧だ at the end of a sentence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主|しゅ}たる⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: main purpose
- {主|しゅ}たる⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: principal cause
- {主|しゅ}たる⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: principal office (legal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧: main, chief (the everyday word)
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧な: major, principal (also formal, but usable as a predicate)
